② Look up and pause every 20–30 min.

caption:
Momo knits for two hours every evening, and the back of her neck feels stiff by the time she finishes.

The longer you look down, the more the muscles at the back of the neck have to hold on. Raising your work on a cushion and taking regular breaks can help. The same goes for sewing, painting, puzzles and other crafts.

Hybi's 1-minute craft break: look up every 20 to 30 minutes, chin tucks for 5 seconds, 5 reps, and slow shoulder rolls. Stop if your arm tingles.

Headaches alongside it, or no change after two weeks, are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
